note: Both sets are padded with duplicated diagram-label component claims, but B captures the key numeric spec — the wire's 15C–30C transformation temperature range — that A omits entirely, and B also correctly derives materials (aluminum louvers/frame, nylon bearing sleeve, ABS parts) and the 3-Axis-CNC mill. A uniquely captures two behavioral facts (contraction on heating, added strain lowering the transition temperature), but its first quote is mangled ('rotates a assembly') and it never states the temperature range. Each set also misbinds a whole-assembly count (250 louvers or 32 rods) to a single 'Screen Assembly', so their error counts are comparable; B's better coverage of the page's quantitative and material facts gives it the edge.
